html:
A city on the Kaloum peninsula and Tombo island, which grew from a small village after the French made it the capital of their coastal colony in the 1890s.

The French laid out a planned town and built a railway inland to Kankan on the Niger, finished in 1914, which drew the produce of the interior to the port. Rubber, bananas and later bauxite left through it. Conakry was the stage of the 1958 vote for independence and the capital of Sekou Toure. It is now home to about a quarter of Guinea's people, and its stadium was the site of the 2009 massacre.
sum: A city on the Kaloum peninsula and Tombo island, which grew from a small village after the French made it the capital of their coastal colony in the 1890s.
